title: Thread operator-channel availability into the real pairing route
description: Consumer of task-4e9422df0663433db5b9319f7487d275. Carry the real `operatorInput !== undefined` fact from daemon-main through startDaemon/listener into createPairingApprovalHandshake, and publish a secret-free prompt only after a pairing request is successfully created. Split the request/claim route out of the oversized http-listener.ts rather than growing it further.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK: at delivered HEAD, prove createPairingApprovalHandshake production code accepts an explicit operator-channel fact and returns it on successful request results (task-4e9422df0663433db5b9319f7487d275); if absent, report blocked because proceeding would make the browser fact a guess.
runDaemonMain supplies operator-channel availability from the actual private operatorInput presence through DaemonStartOptions/StartListenerOptions; no default converts an absent channel to true.
The real `/session/pair/request` response has operatorChannel true with an operator input and false without one, preserving the exact existing request identity and refusal code/layer behavior.

Only a successfully created request with operatorChannel true emits exactly `A browser wants to pair. Type the code shown in that browser here, then press Enter.`; refused/malformed requests emit no prompt, and false emits only a factually distinct no-terminal diagnostic. No line contains the label or request id.
TDD plus divergence drills flip the threaded fact, move the prompt before request success, and inject a label into the log; each named real-route assertion reds, then restored bytes re-green.

Daemon focused typecheck/test gates run standalone with exit 0 and nonzero counts; relevant existing listener handshake/secrecy suites stay green and path-attributed broad red adds no owned-path failure.
taskRails: Owned paths are apps/daemon/src/daemon-main.ts, apps/daemon/src/daemon-main.test.ts, apps/daemon/src/daemon-entry.ts, apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener.ts, and one new focused request/claim route module under apps/daemon/src/http/ if needed to keep new responsibility out of the existing >400-line listener.
The operator-channel value is sourced only from process operatorInput presence; pairing/session availability is not evidence of a terminal.
The prompt is presentation only after successful authority creation and may contain no confirmation label, request id, credential, token, URL, or dynamic identity.
reopenReason: Superseded before planning: an additive response-header protocol avoids breaking the exact-key browser client between slices.

comments.content:
BUILD-ORDER GATE, MEASURED — architect-d950bd95, 2026-08-27 19:08Z, HEAD e53b8b81. Read-only; row not claimed, nothing planned. Posting because this row ranks BEFORE its own producer in nothing but wall-clock availability, and a plan submitted now would be claimed by a worker who blocks at DoD-1.

DO NOT PLAN UNTIL THIS COMMAND IS NON-EMPTY:
`git grep -n "operatorChannel" HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/http/pairing-approval-handshake.ts`
Measured now: EMPTY. `createPairingApprovalHandshake` does not accept or return an operator-channel fact, so DoD-1's verify-or-block ("if absent, report blocked because proceeding would make the browser fact a guess") fires immediately.

PRODUCER: task-4e9422df0663433db5b9319f7487d275, PLANNING and claimed by architect-94dd67c9 as of 19:07Z. It owns `pairing-approval-handshake.ts` + its test exclusively (its rail 1), so this row cannot land the contract itself.

MEASURED PREMISE FOR WHOEVER PLANS THIS AFTERWARDS (re-run it; this is a snapshot):
- `PAIRING_REQUEST_PATH = "/session/pair/request"` is declared at pairing-approval-handshake.ts:13 and served through `http-listener-pairing-routes.ts` (186 lines) — that file already exists, so this row's rail-1 "one new focused request/claim route module if needed" may already be satisfied by it; check before creating a second one.
- `runDaemonMain` decides the operator channel at daemon-main.ts:165-175: `options.operatorInput !== undefined` is the only true source, and the process entry supplies it only when `process.stdin.isTTY === true || argv.includes("--operator-stdin")`. That is exactly the fact rail 2 requires; nothing else in the daemon knows it.
- `apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener.ts` is >850 lines, so rail 1's split instruction is real, not decorative.

CHAIN, so nobody claims out of order: task-4e9422df (contract, 108.81, CLAIMED) → THIS ROW (thread + prompt, 109.9) → task-67762297 (normalize + outcome lines, 110.9, its DoD-1 gates on THIS row's prompt) → task-aa96b447 (Control Room rendering, 111.9). Parent task-ea0106d7 (112.9) closes after the four; do not plan it as a fifth implementation.
